focus_areas: Feather texture consistency and matte finish
White wing bar and tail feather pattern clarity
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Please verify if the leg anatomy shows the correct number of toes (anisodactyl arrangement: three forward, one back) and if the grip on the branch is physically plausible without merging textures. Also, confirm if the orange coloration on the breast transitions naturally into the white belly without abrupt digital banding. Finally, validate that the white wing bars are distinct and not smudged into the surrounding dark feathers.
image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on a thin, leafless branch against a clear blue sky. The bird displays characteristic plumage with a brownish-grey head and upperparts, a bright orange-rufous breast and flanks, and a white belly. It has a short, conical bill that appears yellowish-grey with a dark tip. The wings are folded, showing dark feathers with white markings. The legs are pale and grasp the branch firmly.
